name: food-delivery
description: Food Delivery Order Management System with MVC, SOLID, Strict TDD, and Real-Time SSE

scripts.bundle:api: npx esbuild backend/src/serverless.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=api/index.js && npx esbuild backend/src/serverless.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=api/[...slug].js
scripts.build: npm run bundle:api && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.vercel-build: npm run bundle:api && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.build:all: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test
